name: OH-io State 2023
information: #### This competition does not feature 3x3x3 Cube. The main event is 3x3x3 One-Handed As a result, this competition is not recommended for those looking for a typical competition experience. However, new competitors are still welcome to sign up :) Please consider instead any of the many [other competitions happening in Ohio](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).
